title: Playboy Magazine November 1991 La Toya Jackson Sean Penn Julia Roberts
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, spine wear or address label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, November 1991 issue. Cover price $4.95.

Features:
- La Toya Jackson Does It Again - cover, an all-new pictorial, plus a blast from her autobiography
- A gutty interview with Sean Penn
- 20 Questions: Julia Roberts
- Treachery and Death: The Life and Crimes of a Mafia Prince

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
